scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/font-metrics run build && npm --prefix packages/canvas-renderer run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:core && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:service
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:fonts && npm run test:layout && npm run test:canvas && npm run test:pdf && npm run test:service:pdf && npm run test:editor && npm run test:tools && npm run test:composition && npm run test:release
scripts.test:tools: python3 -m unittest discover -s assets/fonts/tools -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/print-acceptance -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:canvas: npm --prefix packages/font-metrics run build && npm --prefix packages/canvas-renderer test
